Reference / mime/part

mime/part#

MIME messages and parts (RFC 2045, RFC 2046): bodies, multipart bodies, parsing and writing.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let part = ParsedMime(message_bytes).part();
let content = MimeContent(part);
content.type();                          // MediaType
match part.body() { … }                  // a TextBody, BinaryBody or MultipartBody

let mixed = MultipartBody("mixed", boundary, [text_part, attachment]);

Description#

MIME messages and parts (RFC 2045, RFC 2046): bodies, multipart bodies, parsing and writing.

Bodies hold decoded bytes; the Content-Transfer-Encoding is applied when the part is written and undone when it is read.
